# artifactkeeper_system_banner (Resource)

A system-wide maintenance or downtime banner (Artifact Keeper 1.11.0), shown in the web UI and/or sent as a header on API responses inside its display window. Admin-only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Announce a maintenance window in the web UI for its duration.
resource "artifactkeeper_system_banner" "upgrade" {
  title     = "Scheduled maintenance"
  message   = "Artifact Keeper is upgraded tonight; pulls may be slow for a few minutes."
  severity  = "warning"
  target    = "ui"
  link_url  = "https://status.example.com"
  starts_at = "2026-10-20T20:00:00Z"
  ends_at   = "2026-10-20T21:00:00Z"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `message` (String) Banner text.
- `title` (String) Short headline.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Defaults to `true`.
- `ends_at` (String) RFC 3339 instant the banner disappears. Omit to keep it until disabled or destroyed.
- `link_url` (String) Optional call-to-action link, `http` or `https` (e.g. a status page).
- `severity` (String) `info` (default), `warning` or `critical`.
- `starts_at` (String) RFC 3339 instant the banner appears. Omit to show it immediately.
- `target` (String) Where it shows: `all` (default), `ui` or `api`.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Enabled and inside its display window as of the last read.
- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) Banner UUID.
- `updated_at` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import artifactkeeper_system_banner.upgrade <banner-uuid>
```
